en: Sepia-toned postcard showing the interior of a neatly furnished bedroom with strong Central/Eastern European folk decor. There is a double bed with embroidered linens, several wooden chairs, a small dining table covered with an embroidered tablecloth, a dresser with a mirror, and a daybed. On the wall above the bed hangs a large embroidered wall piece with German text. Along the right margin of the image, printed vertically, is German advertising text referring to Sächsische Leinenstickereien and a tapisserie shop in Sibiu/Hermannstadt.
